schema.description: One blood pressure reading as an Open mHealth blood-pressure-4.0 body (omh:blood-pressure:4.0, pinned), with the source's own fields beside it. Two sources write this type: the phone app's export through the anam_bp_csv importer (source bp-csv) and the blood pressure diary read into a records file. Systolic, diastolic, the time frame and posture are the OMH body, written by the importer or the diary reshape from the source's text; every other field is the source's own text, never converted. A field the source left blank is absent, not zero. Version 7 adds source_time (card 198), declared and not required, every other rule unchanged.

systolic_blood_pressure.description: Systolic pressure as an OMH unit-value: the source's printed reading as a number, unit mmHg (the device's; Anam does not check it). Written from the source's text by the importer or the diary reshape.

value.description: The systolic reading, as a number.

diastolic_blood_pressure.description: Diastolic pressure as an OMH unit-value: the source's printed reading as a number, unit mmHg (the device's; Anam does not check it). Written from the source's text by the importer or the diary reshape.

value.description: The diastolic reading, as a number.

effective_time_frame.description: When the reading was taken, as an OMH time frame: date_excel read in Australia/Sydney and written as RFC 3339 with that day's offset. Derived from date_excel, which stays the fact time.

date_time.description: RFC 3339 instant with the Sydney offset in force at the reading.

body_posture.description: The OMH posture mapped from the source's posture: the app's and the diary's "Seated" is sitting, the only posture either has written. Absent when the source gave none.

comment.description: Free-text comment typed in the app, verbatim, typos included.

date.description: The same moment in the app's display form, "Date" column, kept as written. Not used to place the reading.

date_excel.description: When the reading was taken, as the export's "Date (Excel)" column writes it: local wall-clock time in Sydney, no zero padding on month or day. This is the fact time.

id.description: The records row's id, which the diary rows write as date_excel and reading joined by a colon. Diary rows only; bp-csv rows have none.

location.description: Where the cuff was, as written in the "Location" column.

map.description: Mean arterial pressure in mmHg, as the diary printed it. Computed by the diary's app, not by Anam. Diary rows only.

missed_medication.description: The export's "Missed medication" column, as written. Present only when the app recorded it.

note.description: A note printed beside the reading in the diary. Diary rows only.

pp.description: Pulse pressure (systolic minus diastolic) in mmHg, as the diary printed it. Diary rows only.

pulse.description: Pulse as the source printed it, in beats per minute.

reading.description: Which reading this is among those taken at the same date_excel, counting from 1 in file order. Not in the source: the bp-csv worker adds it, because the device can take several readings in one minute and the export gives them no id. With date_excel it is the identity.

weight_kg.description: Body weight entered alongside the reading, "Weight [kg]" column, in kilograms as written.

irregular_heartbeat.description: The export's "Irregular heartbeat" column, as written. Present only when the app recorded it.

dizzy_light_headed.description: The export's "Dizzy / Light-headed" column, as written. Present only when the app recorded it.

temperature_celsius.description: The export's "Temperature [Celsius]" column, body temperature in degrees Celsius as written. Kept as text, so no print of the app's stops a reading.

blood_glucose_mg_dl.description: The export's "Blood Glucose [mg/dL]" column, in mg/dL as written. Kept as text, like temperature_celsius.

oxygen_saturation_pct.description: The export's "Oxygen Saturation [%]" column, in percent as written. Kept as text, like temperature_celsius.

tags.description: The export's "Tags" column, as written, separators included.

source_time.description: How the reading's wall clock was read (card 198): value is date_excel as the source wrote it, read in zone. The anam_bp_csv importer reads it in Australia/Sydney, the zone this Definition reads date_excel in, with basis configuration when its zone key names the cuff's zone and assumption when nothing does. Not required: the diary's rows are written into a records file by hand.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
